scenario: One scene and fixture-owned key window; plain UIHostingController instances, no subclass affecting SDK reflection.

Automatic: default SwiftUI view predicate only, UIKit view predicate disabled; manual: existing trackRUMView modifier only, both automatic view predicates disabled. No raw startView/stopView substitute.

decisive_assertions: Fixed five ordinary view occurrences and matching A/B semantic inventory; preserve any inherited default naming limitation explicitly.
Fresh run/nonce/session, exact source/compiler/product/installed identities, application ID and separate validation service.

Complete source-supported owned window/controller inventory at each boundary; one actual active scene, key-window ownership, positive actual display/native geometry and stable instance identities. No window-cardinality or private class acceptance shortcut.
Actual push/pop didShow and presentation/dismissal completion precede boundary snapshots; SwiftUI appear/disappear callbacks establish actual content transitions.

Every distinct view ID and final inactive lifetime must match full local mapper and complete raw application/session backend inventory. Unexpected owner, duplicate, missing occurrence or new foreign view blocks acceptance.
No gesture-cancellation, interactive dismissal, fold/adaptive layout, automatic-action or physical-device claim. Relevant physical evidence and A02 dependency remain separate release prerequisites.

ApplicationLaunch is a separate source-defined incidental view; exact TTID vital owner/type/name/duration and complete application/session inventory remain required. It is never counted as a sixth hosting occurrence.
